csv_project_name: DB for Lime Island Superintendent's House Roof
csv_agency: State of Michigan Dept of Management & Budget
csv_scope_of_work: Requesting a Design Build entity for development of design documents and installation of a new roof system on the Superintendent s House on Lime Island. The project is to include the removal of all asphalt shingles and roofing felt, repair of any rotten or deteriorated sheathing with treated plywood to match thickness and installation of ice and water shield over the entire roof. Additional work will include removal of the chimney and plumbing vent stacks to below roof profile, with installation of new flashing and asphalt shingles.

title: Design-Build for Lime Island Superintendent's House Roof
short_description: Design-build tender for replacing the roof system of a house on Lime Island.
project_scope: Replacement of the roof system on the Lime Island Superintendent's House, including removal of existing asphalt shingles and roofing felt, repair of rotten or deteriorated roof sheathing with treated plywood matching existing thickness, installation of ice and water shield over the entire roof, removal of chimney and plumbing vent stacks below roof profile, and installation of new flashing and asphalt shingles.
services: Design-build services for preparation of design documents and execution of roof replacement works.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale roof replacement on an existing house.
- Primarily a building maintenance/repair project, not a new complex structure.
- No indication of long spans, special structural systems, or innovative engineering.
- Limited relevance to sbp's focus on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and complex buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The scope is limited to roof replacement and minor associated repairs on a house, but the documents provide no area, dimensions, or budget, so a realistic USD estimate is not reliable.
fee_explanation: No planning fee is stated in the source. The tender is for design-build roof replacement works, and no separate engineering fee information is provided.
references_qualifications: Design-build entity requested; no specific reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
